item.title: Exact Copy App Ad

exact_text: Plan your day in one place.

turns.text: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 ad for my fictional planning app DayNest. Three equal-length scenes with these exact lines, one per scene in this order: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' / 'Plan your day in one place.' / 'Try DayNest today.' Keep capitals and punctuation exactly. No other visible words, even in the background. Use simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green.

item.tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

answer_sheet.Exact on-screen copy:
Scene 1: Less scrolling. More doing.
Scene 2: Plan your day in one place.
Scene 3: Try DayNest today.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and green with simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes; layout and font are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Silent; English text exactly as supplied.

must_haves: The final video is 9 seconds long, landscape 16:9, with three equal 3-second scenes.
The first scene reads exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
The second scene reads exactly 'Plan your day in one place.'
The third scene reads exactly 'Try DayNest today.'
Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a SILENT 9-second 16:9 minimalist motion-graphics advertisement for fictional planning app DayNest. Exactly three scenes, each exactly 3 seconds long: scene 1 at 0.000–3.000 seconds, scene 2 at 3.000–6.000 seconds, scene 3 at 6.000–9.000 seconds. Use hard cuts at 3 and 6 seconds to preserve exact scene timing. Locked camera, flat vector shapes, warm cream background (#F7F2E7), forest-green (#285B43) and sage-green accents. Simple animated calendar outlines and checkmark shapes, generous negative space, calm friendly polished design. NO SOUND, no speech, no music. Typography is clean, large, legible, green sans serif. Render the following exact lines, preserving capitalization and punctuation. These lines are the ONLY visible words anywhere in the video. Do not add a logo wordmark, app name separately, calendar month or day names, letters, numbers, labels, interface text, captions, watermark, or any other writing. Calendar grids must contain only blank cells or geometric checkmarks. Scene 1 (0–3s): exact text 'Less scrolling. More doing.' centered and fully visible throughout this scene; above it, small green rounded rectangles smoothly organize into a simple blank calendar outline and a checkmark draws itself. Scene 2 (3–6s): replace prior text completely with exact text 'Plan your day in one place.' centered and fully visible throughout this scene; above it, a simple green calendar with blank cells and three checkmarks gently snapping into cells. Scene 3 (6–9s): replace prior text completely with exact text 'Try DayNest today.' centered and fully visible throughout this scene; above it a large checkmark completes inside a rounded calendar shape, with a subtle settling bounce. Keep all lettering stationary and sharp; animate only shapes. No overlapping text between scenes. No extra end card or transitions beyond the nine seconds. Final frame holds scene 3.
